```{julia}
using Statistics

active_fraction(sdf) = mean(.!sdf.suppressed)  # scalar in [0,1]
suppressed_fraction(sdf) = mean(sdf.suppressed) # also useful

using DataFrames, Statistics

function active_fraction_by_epoch(sdf::DataFrame)
    combine(groupby(sdf, :epoch),
        :suppressed => (x -> mean(.!x)) => :active_frac,
        :suppressed => mean => :suppressed_frac,
        nrow => :n_rows,
    )
end

function active_fraction_by_bee(sdf::DataFrame)
    combine(groupby(sdf, :bee_id),
        :suppressed => (x -> mean(.!x)) => :active_frac,
        :suppressed => mean => :suppressed_frac,
    )
end

function summarize_suppression(sdf::DataFrame)
    (
      active = mean(.!sdf.suppressed),
      suppressed = mean(sdf.suppressed),
      active_by_epoch = active_fraction_by_epoch(sdf),
      active_by_bee = active_fraction_by_bee(sdf),
    )
end
```

```{julia}
using DataFrames, Statistics

# overall active fraction (you already did)
active_fraction(sdf) = mean(.!sdf.suppressed)

# per-agent active fraction averaged over tasks and time
function active_fraction_by_bee(sdf::DataFrame)
    combine(groupby(sdf, [:bee_id, :epoch]),
        :suppressed => (x -> mean(.!x)) => :active_frac_epoch
    ) |>
    df -> combine(groupby(df, :bee_id),
        :active_frac_epoch => mean => :active_frac
    )
end

# fraction of "dead" agents: active fraction below eps
function dead_agent_fraction(sdf::DataFrame; eps=0.05)
    b = active_fraction_by_bee(sdf)
    mean(b.active_frac .< eps), b
end
```
